description: UNDERSTANDING — A provider's REAL score time series: one point per scored build (composite + agent readiness on each date), plus a summary of the movement over the window — first/last, net change, direction, and the largest single-build jump with the date it happened. Not an implied previous point; these are the recorded snapshots. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back.
